BENQODHI is building a set of candidate benchmark problems at the intersection of
optimisation, life sciences and health. This page is the future entry point for
reviewed benchmark problem pages.

Candidates are welcome from anyone — see [Contribute](../contribute.qmd) for how to
propose one.

::: {.callout-note}
The Day 2 workshop material is separate from this page. For table structure,
discussion questions and seed problems, see the [Round Tables](../roundtables/index.qmd)
section.
:::

## Benchmark Entry Template

Every candidate problem is described using the same structure, so proposals, working
notes and finished problem pages can stay comparable:

1. **Use case** — the biological or clinical task, and why it matters
2. **Formal problem** — objective, decision variables, constraints
3. **Instances** — real, synthetic or generated; provenance, scale, format
4. **Source of difficulty** — why it is hard
5. **Baselines** — current methods and available implementations
6. **Metrics** — success measures, resource accounting
7. **Ready vs. missing** — honest gap analysis
8. **Next action** — one named person, one concrete step

## Published Problem Pages

::: {.callout-note}
No reviewed benchmark problem pages have been published yet.
:::

After the workshop, selected candidates will be written up here as benchmark problem
entries only when their formulation, data or instances, baselines, metrics and
ownership are clear enough to make them useful to others.

## Datasets

No benchmark datasets have been published yet. Once instances exist for a reviewed
problem, they will be linked from that problem's page, along with generator code
where applicable.
